args.title: Fix export filename date to use local date instead of UTC date
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename uses at.toISOString().slice(0,10) to generate the date in the export filename, which is based on UTC date. Change it to use the local date of 'at' to prevent exports made in the evening local time from getting the next day's date in the filename.
